ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

HoverStyles.helper: Choose the hover styles from the available options.

DefaultStyles.helper: Choose the default styles from the available options.

Image.helper: Choose the image or file to use for image. Use a clear file that fits this content.

GridWidth.helper: Choose the grid width from the available options.

ProjectTitle.helper: Enter the project title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ProjectType.helper: Enter the project type to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

SmallPicture.helper: Choose the image or file to use for small picture. Use a clear file that fits this content.

FadeInTitle.helper: Enter the fade in title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

FadeInText.helper: Enter the fade in text to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

FadeInButtomText.helper: Enter the fade in buttom text to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

FullName.helper: Enter the person's first and last name.

Name.helper: Enter the name to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

URL.helper: Enter the web addresses to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

SocialMedia.helper: Add and arrange the items used for social media. Remove any item you do not need.

PricipalSocialMedia.helper: Enter the pricipal social media to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

PricipalIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Text.helper: Enter the text for text. Use short paragraphs so it is easy to read.

CardText.helper: Add and arrange the items used for card text. Remove any item you do not need.

Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

IconColor.helper: Choose the icon color from the available options.

href.helper: Enter the href to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

Icons.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Bottom.helper: Choose the bottom from the available options.

NoBorders.helper: Turn this setting on or off to control no borders.

Items.helper: Add and arrange the items used for items. Remove any item you do not need.
